paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," ranges from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," ranges from 12 to 28, also on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The legend identifies four distinct lines: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circles), Inconsistency-CE (purple dashed line with squares), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with squares), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with stars). All four lines exhibit an increasing trend as the average lagging increases. At an average lagging of 0, the BLEU scores are approximately 14.0 for Consistency-CE, 20.0 for Inconsistency-CE, 20.0 for Inconsistency-CE-MP, and 22.5 for Consistency-Bi. As the average lagging increases to 6, the BLEU scores rise to approximately 26.5 for Consistency-CE, 26.5 for Inconsistency-CE, 26.5 for Inconsistency-CE-MP, and 28.0 for Consistency-Bi. The Consistency-Bi line consistently achieves the highest BLEU score across the entire range of average lagging values.
